description: MSSQL Motor.agrafana. Один фильтр Модель (multi): main_* и second_* из логов. Финэффект/gap только для stem в слоте main. Import JSON.

options.content:
**Модель** — весь дашборд (multi: main_* и second_*)  
**Филиал** — доля потока + gap  
Датадрифт: один расчёт на модель (cf∪rg фичи, track=`all`)  
Финэффект только для stem в слоте main

panels.title: Число ошибок по модели
panels.description: Фильтр: Модель. Число строк с РезультатПроверки=-1 по дням × модель

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(run_date AS DATETIME2) AS [time],
  COALESCE(NULLIF(model_label, ''), stem) AS metric,
  CAST(SUM([count]) AS FLOAT) AS [value]
FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_errors]
WHERE stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
GROUP BY CAST(run_date AS DATETIME2), COALESCE(NULLIF(model_label, ''), stem)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Топ отпечатков traceback
panels.description: Фильтр: Модель. Группировка по нормализованному traceback (error_head)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(run_date AS DATETIME2) AS [time],
  COALESCE(NULLIF(model_label, ''), stem) + N' | ' + LEFT(error_head, 80) AS metric,
  CAST(SUM([count]) AS FLOAT) AS [value]
FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_errors]
WHERE stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
GROUP BY CAST(run_date AS DATETIME2), COALESCE(NULLIF(model_label, ''), stem) + N' | ' + LEFT(error_head, 80)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT TOP 50 model_label, model_kind, model_version, error_fingerprint,
  LEFT(error_head, 120) AS error_head, SUM([count]) AS [всего]
FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_errors]
WHERE stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
GROUP BY model_label, model_kind, model_version, error_fingerprint, LEFT(error_head, 120)
ORDER BY [всего] DESC

SELECT TOP 200 [date], model_name, model_version, track, col, [TYPE],
  ROUND(CAST([PSI] AS FLOAT), 4) AS [PSI], ROUND(CAST([KL] AS FLOAT), 4) AS [KL],
  ROUND(CAST([NaN_train] AS FLOAT), 4) AS [NaN_train], ROUND(CAST([NaN_test] AS FLOAT), 4) AS [NaN_test],
  mode_train, mode_test, mean_train, mean_test,
  dif_train AS [только в train],
  dif_test AS [только в test]
FROM [agrafana].[querulus_DataDrift]
WHERE stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
  AND [PSI] > 0.3
ORDER BY [PSI] DESC

SELECT
  CAST([date] AS DATETIME2) AS [time],
  COALESCE(NULLIF(model_name, ''), stem) + N' | ' + col AS metric,
  CAST(AVG([PSI]) AS FLOAT) AS [value]
FROM [agrafana].[querulus_DataDrift]
WHERE stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
GROUP BY CAST([date] AS DATETIME2), COALESCE(NULLIF(model_name, ''), stem) + N' | ' + col
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  CAST([date] AS DATETIME2) AS [time],
  COALESCE(NULLIF(model_name, ''), stem) AS metric,
  CAST(MAX([PSI]) AS FLOAT) AS [value]
FROM [agrafana].[querulus_DataDrift]
WHERE stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
GROUP BY CAST([date] AS DATETIME2), COALESCE(NULLIF(model_name, ''), stem)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT model_name, model_version,
  COUNT(*) AS [признаков],
  ROUND(CAST(MAX([PSI]) AS FLOAT), 4) AS [макс PSI],
  SUM(CASE WHEN [PSI] > 0.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [PSI>0.3]
FROM [agrafana].[querulus_DataDrift]
WHERE stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
  AND [date] = (SELECT MAX([date]) FROM [agrafana].[querulus_DataDrift])
GROUP BY model_name, model_version
ORDER BY model_name

panels.title: 3. Финэффект  ·  фильтр: Модель  ·  «Доля потока» ещё Филиал
Эффект на 1 убыток (ITT)
panels.description: Только модель в слоте main. Фильтр: Модель. Средняя экономия на один убыток (Yult ITT)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(week_start AS DATETIME2) AS [time],
  COALESCE(NULLIF(model_label, ''), stem) AS metric,
  CAST(AVG(itt) AS FLOAT) AS [value]
FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_FinEffect]
WHERE slot = N'main'
  AND stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
  AND filial = N'(все)'
GROUP BY CAST(week_start AS DATETIME2), COALESCE(NULLIF(model_label, ''), stem)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Доля потока в модель
panels.description: Только модель в слоте main. Фильтр: Филиал. Какая доля eligible-потока ушла в рукав model.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(week_start AS DATETIME2) AS [time],
  COALESCE(NULLIF(model_label, ''), stem) + N' | ' + filial AS metric,
  CAST(AVG(coverage) AS FLOAT) AS [value]
FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_FinEffect]
WHERE slot = N'main'
  AND stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
  AND filial <> N'(все)'
  AND (
    '${filial}' = '__all__'
    OR filial = N'${filial}'
  )
GROUP BY CAST(week_start AS DATETIME2), COALESCE(NULLIF(model_label, ''), stem) + N' | ' + filial
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Годовой эффект без участия людей
panels.description: Только модель в слоте main. Фильтр: Модель. Вся сеть, 100% потока в model и всегда исполнять рекомендацию (ITT_100)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(week_start AS DATETIME2) AS [time],
  COALESCE(NULLIF(model_label, ''), stem) AS metric,

panels.title: Сводка финэффекта

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 100 week_start AS [неделя],
  model_label AS [модель],
  n_incidents AS [убытков],
  n_model AS [в model],
  ROUND(CAST(itt AS FLOAT), 2) AS [эффект на 1 убыток],
  ROUND(CAST(coverage AS FLOAT), 4) AS [доля в model],
  ROUND(CAST(annual_window_yult AS FLOAT), 0) AS [эффект за период (50/50)],
  ROUND(CAST(annual_pilot_current_yult AS FLOAT), 0) AS [год пилот 50/50],
  ROUND(CAST(annual_pilot_full_yult AS FLOAT), 0) AS [год пилот (100%)],
  ROUND(CAST(annual_network_current_yult AS FLOAT), 0) AS [год все филиалы (50/50)],
  ROUND(CAST(annual_network_full_yult AS FLOAT), 0) AS [год все филиалы (100%)],
  ROUND(CAST(annual_network_full_compliance_yult AS FLOAT), 0) AS [год без участия людей],
  formula_version AS [версия формулы]
FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_FinEffect]
WHERE slot = N'main'
  AND stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
  AND filial = N'(все)'
ORDER BY week_start DESC, stem

panels.description: Только модель в слоте main. Фильтр: Модель.

panels.title: 4. Gap долей за весь период  ·  Модель + Филиал
Gap за весь период (model − control), п.п.
panels.description: Только модель в слоте main. Фильтр: Модель + Филиал. Кумулятив с старта пилота. Плюс у соглашений = в model доля выше; минус у претензий/ФУ/суда = в model доля ниже (снижение).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(CAST(AVG(agreement_share_lift_pp) AS FLOAT), 1) AS [Соглашения],
  ROUND(CAST(AVG(pretension_share_lift_pp) AS FLOAT), 1) AS [Претензии],
  ROUND(CAST(AVG(fu_share_lift_pp) AS FLOAT), 1) AS [ФУ],
  ROUND(CAST(AVG(court_share_lift_pp) AS FLOAT), 1) AS [Суд]
FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_FinEffect]
WHERE slot = N'main'
  AND stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
  AND (
    ('${filial}' = '__all__' AND filial = N'(все)')
    OR ('${filial}' <> '__all__' AND filial = N'${filial}')
  )

panels.title: Филиалы: «без инструментов» model < control
panels.description: Только модель в слоте main. Фильтр: Модель (+ Филиал). Доля соглашений без инструментов среди инцидентов: в model меньше, чем в control. gap = control − model, п.п.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  filial AS [filial],
  ROUND(CAST(agr_control_pct AS FLOAT), 1) AS [agr control %],
  ROUND(CAST(agr_model_pct AS FLOAT), 1) AS [agr model %],
  ROUND(CAST(gap_pp AS FLOAT), 1) AS [gap п.п.]
FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_FinEffect]
WHERE slot = N'main'
  AND stem IN (${model:sqlstring})
  AND gap_pp IS NOT NULL
  AND filial <> N'(все)'
  AND (
    '${filial}' = '__all__'
    OR filial = N'${filial}'
  )
ORDER BY gap_pp DESC, filial

list.name: model
list.label: Модель
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT stem AS __text, stem AS __value FROM (
  SELECT stem FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_errors]
  UNION
  SELECT stem FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_FinEffect]
  UNION
  SELECT stem FROM [agrafana].[querulus_DataDrift]
) t ORDER BY 1

list.name: filial
list.label: Филиал
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT filial FROM [agrafana].[Querulus_FinEffect] WHERE filial <> N'(все)' ORDER BY 1
